description: This file defines the LeadFormBase class, which extends PersonFormBase to handle form generation, validation, and saving logic for lead records within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for rendering forms, handling duplicates, linking leads to accounts, and processing lead save operations.

classes.name: LeadFormBase
classes.description: A class extending PersonFormBase specifically for handling Lead entity forms, including rendering, duplicate checking, and saving logic within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDuplicateQuery
methods.description: Constructs and returns the SQL query used to identify potential duplicate leads based on provided first and last names.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates HTML markup for a detailed lead form with comprehensive fields such as name, address, phone, email, and description.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Creates a simplified lead form with essential fields like name, phone, and email.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Assembles the complete HTML form for creating or editing a lead, including headers, form fields, and submit button.

methods.name: handleLeadAccountName
methods.description: Associates a lead with an account based on the account name, updating the account ID accordingly.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes the lead form submission, including duplicate detection, saving the lead, linking to prospects, handling inbound emails, and redirecting after save.
